page_title: LEN 1-0 ETI | Lens v St Etienne 06/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mathew Ryan intercepts the ball.
90+4' Lens failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' A cross from a corner kick by Lens is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
87' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Hamzat Ojediran (Lens), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
87' The manager makes a subsitution with Yunis Abdelhamid (St Etienne) coming on for Leo Petrot.
86' Will Still prepares a substitution. Andy Diouf is replaced by Angelo Fulgini (Lens).
86' That's the end of the game for Deiver Machado, who is replaced by Hamzat Ojediran (Lens).
85' Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Romain Lissorgue stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
83' Romain Lissorgue interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Andy Diouf (Lens).
81' Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) is adjudged offside.
80' The opposition can't get near Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just over the bar at the last second.
79' Here is a change. Ruben Aguilar is going off and Will Still gives the last tactical orders to Kyllian Antonio (Lens).
77' Dangerous play by Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne). Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul.

75' 1 - 0 Goal! A terrific long pass from Deiver Machado picks out an unmarked Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball low into the middle of the goal. 1:0.

74' Abdulay Juma Bah (Lens) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
74' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) is about to take a corner kick.
73' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
70' Golden chance! Ruben Aguilar (Lens) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
68' Eirik Horneland has decided to make a change. Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne) replaces Irvin Cardona.
68' We are about to witness a subsitution. Benjamin Old (St Etienne) for Zuriko Davitashvili.
68' The linesman signals that Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
67' Deiver Machado (Lens) decides to have a direct shot at goal from the free kick, but the ball goes high over the top of the crossbar.
66' Will Still decides to make a substitution. Florian Sotoca will be replaced by Anass Zaroury (Lens).
66' The substitution has been made. Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) has replaced Wesley Said.
65' What was Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
65' Deiver Machado (Lens) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
62' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Eirik Horneland is forced to make a change. Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Aimen Moueffek.
54' The game is interrupted now, Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
53' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
52' Flag up against Deiver Machado (Lens). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
50' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lens comes to nothing.
50' Facundo Medina (Lens) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
49' Leo Petrot (St Etienne) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Romain Lissorgue blows for a foul.
46' Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Romain Lissorgue has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+6' A player from St Etienne commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
45+5' St Etienne will take a corner kick.

45+5' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom right corner. Mathew Ryan anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
45+4' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+3' Malang Sarr (Lens) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. The referee gives a penalty kick to St Etienne!!
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' Leo Petrot (St Etienne) makes a slide tackle, but referee Romain Lissorgue blows for a foul.
41' Andy Diouf (Lens) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Gautier Larsonneur gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
37' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
34' St Etienne fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
32' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
30' Romain Lissorgue shows a yellow card to Facundo Medina (Lens) for his blatant foul.
29' A corner kick by Lens is thwarted by the well prepared Gautier Larsonneur (St Etienne).
29' The corner is swung in but Lens can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

28' Ambitious effort from Andy Diouf (Lens). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
26' Wesley Said (Lens) commits a rough foul. Romain Lissorgue stops the game and makes a call.
22' Wesley Said (Lens) commits a foul and Romain Lissorgue immediately signals a free kick.
19' Deiver Machado (Lens) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
17' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
16' Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
15' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
15' The goal by Lens won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
14' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Lens players aren’t happy.
12' Goal! Ruben Aguilar displays great vision and sends a pass to Deiver Machado (Lens), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. The score is 1:0.
8' Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

8' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the right post. Mathew Ryan has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
6' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
3' Florian Sotoca (Lens) is caught offside!
1' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Lens will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Romain Lissorgue.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
